generate_dialog.title: Generate a new key
generate_dialog.description: Pick a name you'll recognize later — e.g. {example}. The token itself is shown only once.
generate_dialog.name: Name

reveal_dialog.title: Copy your new API key
reveal_dialog.description: This is the only time you'll see {name}. Store it somewhere safe — if you lose it, generate a new one.
reveal_dialog.warning: Treat this like a password. Anyone with it can provision agents on your behalf.

revoke_dialog.title: Revoke API key
revoke_dialog.description: Revoke {name}? Any service using this token will stop working immediately. This action cannot be undone.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Plug third-party services into your account once, then attach them to any agent. Pick from the catalog or add any MCP server by URL.

add_modal.title: Add custom connector
add_modal.description: Point the chat at any MCP server. Modern servers (Notion, Linear, Atlassian, …) advertise OAuth — pick that and we'll handle sign-in. Older servers usually take a bearer token.
add_modal.hint_oauth: We'll discover the auth server and run sign-in for you.
add_modal.hint_token: We'll send your token as a Bearer header on every call.
add_modal.hint_none: The server is reachable without auth.
add_modal.error: Could not add this connector — check the URL and try again.

salesforce.description: Salesforce uses a per-org OAuth app. Create an External Client App in your org, then enter its Consumer Key below — you'll approve access on Salesforce next.
salesforce.help_link: How to create an External Client App
salesforce.consumer_secret_placeholder: Leave blank for a PKCE public app
salesforce.my_domain_hint: Leave blank to sign in via login.salesforce.com. Required if your org enforces My Domain.
salesforce.error: Could not start the connection — please check the details and try again.

token_modal.server_url_hint: {name} has no hosted MCP server — paste the URL of your own (self-hosted or partner-managed) {name} MCP server.
token_modal.format_warning: The format doesn't look right. Double-check the value before connecting.
token_modal.error: Could not connect — please try again.

members.title: Chatters
members.description: Everyone you've granted access to chat with your agents. Send a password reset link or remove a chatter entirely.
members.invite_disabled_hint: Create a protected agent first — chatters can only be invited to protected agents.

empty.title: No chatters yet.
empty.description: Invite someone below, or from any agent's Chatters tab — they'll show up here.

no_results.title: No chatters found matching your search.

invite_dialog.title: Invite a chatter
invite_dialog.description: We'll email a sign-up link to this address. Pick the agents they can chat with — at least one is required.
invite_dialog.agents_hint: The chatter can chat only with the agents you select.
invite_dialog.emailed_to: Invitation emailed to {email}. You can also copy the link below.

reset_dialog.title: Send a password reset link?
reset_dialog.description: We'll email a reset link to {email}. They can set a new password from the link — you won't see the new value.

delete_dialog.title: Remove chatter
delete_dialog.description: {name} will be permanently deleted along with their access to every agent in your workspace. This cannot be undone.

toast.reset_failed: Could not send the reset link

governance.title: Audit log
governance.description: Every action your agents take through tools and connectors — allowed, approved, denied, or rate-limited — with the arguments, result, and who triggered it.

security.title: Security
security.description: Workspace-wide security controls. Restrict who can reach your dashboard by network — trusted IP addresses and countries.
security.save_error: Could not save your security settings

teaser.title: Security & Compliance
teaser.description: Lock your workspace down to trusted networks and meet your compliance needs. Available on the Pro plan.
teaser.ip: IP allowlist — only approved addresses can sign in
teaser.geo: Country rules — allow or block access by country
teaser.more: Plus data retention, SIEM webhooks, SSO / SCIM and more

network.title: Network access control
network.help: Restrict dashboard access to trusted IP addresses and countries. When off, anyone with a valid login can sign in from anywhere.

ip.title: Allowed IP addresses
ip.help: Only these addresses can reach the dashboard. Leave empty to allow any IP (country rules still apply). You can't save a list that excludes your current address.
ip.dialog_description: Add the IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed to reach your dashboard. Example: 203.0.113.4 or 203.0.113.0/24.
ip.empty_draft: No addresses yet — add one below.

geo.title: Country rules
geo.help: Allow or block dashboard access based on the visitor's country.
geo.dialog_description: Pick the countries this rule applies to.
geo.lockout_allow: Your current location ({country}) isn't in the allowed countries — saving will lock you out of the dashboard. Add it, or switch the rule, first.
geo.lockout_deny: Your current location ({country}) is in the blocked countries — saving will lock you out of the dashboard. Remove it, or switch the rule, first.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.help: How long Chatvia keeps your data before deleting it automatically. Shorten these for compliance — leave a field blank to use the default.
retention.conversations_help: Chat history is deleted after this many days. Up to {max} on your plan.

siem.title: SIEM webhook
siem.help: Forward every security event to your SIEM in real time, signed so you can verify it came from Chatvia.
siem.secret_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current secret
siem.secret_help: Used to HMAC-sign each delivery so your SIEM can verify it.
siem.signature_help: Each POST is signed with HMAC-SHA256 in the X-Chatvia-Signature header.
siem.upsell: Stream signed security events to your SIEM in real time. Available on the Enterprise plan.

security_audit.title: Security audit log
security_audit.description: An immutable record of every sign-in, membership change, configuration change, and data event in your workspace.

teaser.title: Security audit log
teaser.description: See every sign-in, role change, and security setting change — tamper-evident and exportable. Available on the Pro plan.

profile.title: Profile settings

password.subtitle: Manage your account's password.
password.update_description: Ensure your account is using a strong, secure password to protect your account.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.heading: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.description: Require a 6-digit code from an authenticator app at sign-in, in addition to your password.
two_factor.disable_description: Your account will only be protected by your password. You can turn 2FA back on anytime.
two_factor.off_description: Turn it on to require a 6-digit code at sign-in.
two_factor.finish_setup_description: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code to confirm.
two_factor.recovery_description: Save these one-time codes somewhere safe. Each can unlock your account if you lose your authenticator.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.name_required: Give your passkey a name first.
passkeys.heading: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in with your fingerprint, face, or security key — no password needed.
passkeys.no_passkeys_hint: Add a passkey to sign in faster on this device.
passkeys.dialog_description: Choose a name so you can tell your passkeys apart later.
passkeys.delete_description: {name} will no longer be able to sign in. This can't be undone.

social.title: Social accounts
social.heading: Social accounts
social.description: Connect Google, Microsoft, or Slack to sign in with one click and keep your accounts in sync.
social.disconnect_description: You won't be able to sign in with {provider} until you connect it again.

data_export.title: Download my data
data_export.heading: Download a copy of my data
data_export.description: Get a ZIP archive containing every piece of personal data we hold about you — your agents, conversations, messages, knowledge sources, and uploaded files. Prepared in line with GDPR Articles 15 and 20.
data_export.idle_description: Building the archive runs in the background — we'll email you when it's ready. The download stays available for 24 hours, then it's deleted from our servers.
data_export.request_button: Request a copy of my data
data_export.processing_description: We're packaging your data into a ZIP file. This usually takes a few minutes — we'll send you an email once it's ready, and this page will refresh automatically.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.subtitle: Permanently delete your account and everything in it.
delete.data_export_title: Want a copy of your data first?
delete.data_export_description: Once your account is gone, your data is gone with it. You can {link} of everything we hold about you before you delete.
delete.removes_intro: Deleting your account permanently removes everything in it, including:
delete.removes_knowledge: Knowledge sources, documents, and uploaded files
delete.removes_team: Your team, chatters, API keys, and connectors
delete.agents_will_delete: {count} agent will be permanently deleted: | {count} agents will be permanently deleted:
delete.subscription_cancel: Your active subscription will be canceled and you won't be billed again.
delete.email_confirmed: Email confirmed. This is your last step — there's no going back after this.
delete.final_dialog_description: This will permanently delete your account and all of its data, and cannot be undone.
delete.final_dialog_subscription: Your subscription will also be canceled.
delete.check_email: Check your email — we sent a confirmation link to finish deleting your account. It expires in 30 minutes. Open the link to continue.
delete.password_dialog_description: Enter your password to continue. We'll email you a confirmation link to finish deleting your account.

confirm_password.title: Confirm your password

confirm_password.error: Could not confirm password. Please try again.

response_settings.title: Response Settings
response_settings.description_widget: Control how your AI agent responds. These settings will be applied to the selected model and affect the style and creativity of all responses.
response_settings.description_default: Control how your AI agent responds. These settings will be applied to all selected models and affect the style and creativity of all responses.

temperature.label: Creativity Level
temperature.help: Low = predictable, consistent responses. High = more creative, varied answers.

top_k.label: Word Choice Variety
top_k.help: 0 = disabled. Lower = uses more common words. Higher = considers more word options.

top_p.label: Response Focus
top_p.help: Lower = more focused responses. Higher = broader, more diverse responses.

presence_penalty.label: Avoid Repeating Topics
presence_penalty.help: Higher values discourage repeating the same topics or ideas.

frequency_penalty.label: Avoid Repeating Words
frequency_penalty.help: Higher values discourage using the same words multiple times.

persona_editor.label: Instructions (System prompt)
persona_editor.description: Define how your AI agent should behave and respond to users
persona_editor.library_hint: Using the saved prompt {name} (read-only). Manage it in Settings → Prompts, or switch to {base} to edit a copy for just this agent.
